params.name: filter[metadata.status][]
params.description: Requesting the API to return records with the specified statuses only. To filter the records for multiple values, add the filter string multiple times. For example, if you need to get records that have either "New" or "Open" status, pass the filters as follows `?filter[metadata.status][]=New&filter[metadata.status][]=Open`. For more information, see Making requests
